name: Timeless
driverConfig: 1 × 14.2mm planar magnetic (double-sided N52 magnet array, ultra-thin diaphragm)

materials.shell: CNC-machined aviation-grade aluminum with hard oxidation
materials.cable: Single crystal copper + silver-plated single crystal copper with silver foil

pros: Landmark planar performance that popularized budget planars
Deep, textured bass for a planar
Solid aluminum build and distinctive circular design
Very good technical performance for the price
cons: Treble can be peaky/bright for sensitive listeners (especially around 8 kHz)
Benefits noticeably from a source with good current delivery
Large circular shells may not fit smaller ears comfortably
Tip selection is critical for seal and bass response
insight: The original Timeless is one of the most important IEMs of the early 2020s. It brought genuine planar magnetic performance — speed, resolution, and textured bass — to a price point that previously only offered dynamic drivers. Reviewers almost universally praised its technical ability and the way it democratized planar sound. The main point of contention remains the treble, which some find exciting and others find a bit sharp depending on tip choice and source. Even years later it remains a frequently recommended benchmark when evaluating newer planar IEMs.
